---
title: "J20 Fos"
output: html_notebook
---
Libraries
```{r}
library(ggplot2)    #plot graphs
library(ggpubr)     #edit graphs with theme()
library(tidyverse)  #group of packages includes dplyr etc
library(foreign)    #read in SPSS files
library(svglite)    #export grobs as SVG files
library(rstatix)    #allows for pipeline stats
library(afex)       #mixed ANOVA
```
```{r}
# Colour palette define
GenotypeColour <- c(
  "Tg" = "#EA2376",
  "WT" = "#6D47B4"
)

```
Read in SPSS file
```{r}
#set working directory
setwd("~/Library/CloudStorage/Dropbox/Manuscripts/ATN to RSC J20/J20 data/R scripts")

# Read in data file --------------------------------------------

#read in SPSS file to data frame
Fos<-read.spss("J20_Fos_all.sav", use.value.label=TRUE, to.data.frame=TRUE)

#transposed file for mixed ANOVA
Fos.tr<- read.spss("J20_Fos_transposed.sav", use.value.label=TRUE, to.data.frame=TRUE)
```

```{r}
#calculate Fos average over entire RSC if needed
library(dplyr)
Fos<- mutate(Fos, RSC=(dRSC+gRSC)/2)

#normality tests
hist(Fos$RSC)
Fos%>% group_by(Age,Genotype)%>% shapiro_test(dRSC)
Fos%>% group_by(Age,Genotype)%>% shapiro_test(gRSC)

#descriptive statistics
Fos%>%
  group_by(Age,Genotype)%>%
  summarise(mean=mean(dRSC), SD=sd(dRSC), median=median(dRSC),IQR1=quantile(dRSC,0.25),IQR3=quantile(dRSC,0.75))
Fos%>%
  group_by(Age,Genotype)%>%
  summarise(mean=mean(gRSC), SD=sd(gRSC), median=median(gRSC),IQR1=quantile(gRSC,0.25),IQR3=quantile(gRSC,0.75))

```
Mixed ANOVA for dRSC and gRSC
```{r}
#mixed 3-way ANOVA: WS - RSC sub-region, BS - Age and Genotype
Fos_mixaov <- aov_ez(id="ID", dv="RSC", data=Fos.tr, between=c("Age","Genotype"), within="Subregion")
summary(Fos_mixaov)

#mixed 4-way ANOVA: WS - RSC sub-region, BS - Age, Genotype and Sex
Fos_mixaov_sex <- aov_ez(id="ID", dv="RSC", data=Fos.tr, between=c("Age","Genotype","Sex"), within="Subregion")
summary(Fos_mixaov_sex)

#post hoc tests
Fos%>% group_by(Genotype)%>% pairwise_t_test(dRSC ~ Age, p.adjust.method="BH")
Fos%>% group_by(Genotype)%>% pairwise_t_test(gRSC ~ Age, p.adjust.method="BH")
Fos%>% pairwise_t_test(dRSC ~ Age, p.adjust.method="BH")
Fos%>% pairwise_t_test(gRSC ~ Age, p.adjust.method="BH")

#boxplot
mix.plot<- 
  Fos.tr%>%
  ggplot(aes(x=Age, y=RSC, fill=Genotype))+
 geom_boxplot(outlier.shape=NA, alpha = 0.8)+  # alpha for transparency+
  geom_point(colour="black", size = 0.5, position=position_jitterdodge())+
  scale_fill_manual(values=GenotypeColour)+
  facet_wrap(vars(Subregion), ncol=2, scales="fixed")+
#  stat_summary(fun.y = mean, geom = "errorbar", aes(ymax = ..y.., ymin = ..y.., group=Genotype), width = .7, linetype = "dashed", position=position_dodge())+
  labs(y = "Fos+ cells/mm2", x= "Age (months)")+
  scale_x_discrete(labels=c("3","6","9"))+
  theme_classic2()+
  theme(axis.text.x=element_text(size=12), axis.text.y=element_text(size=12),
        strip.text=element_text(size=12), 
        legend.title=element_text(size=12), legend.text=element_text(size=12))

#save as PDF file
ggsave(file="RSC Fos boxplot.pdf", plot=mix.plot, height=3, width=7)
```

ANOVA for other regions
```{r}
#normality tests
Fos%>% group_by(Age,Genotype)%>% shapiro_test(CA1)
Fos%>% group_by(Age,Genotype)%>% shapiro_test(VC)
Fos%>% group_by(Age,Genotype)%>% shapiro_test(EC)

#CA1 2-way ANOVA
CA1.aov <- aov(CA1 ~ Genotype + Age + Genotype*Age, data=Fos)
summary(CA1.aov)
Fos%>% pairwise_t_test(CA1 ~ Age, p.adjust.method="BH")
Fos%>% group_by(Age)%>% pairwise_t_test(CA1 ~ Genotype, p.adjust.method="BH")

#CA1 boxplot
  CA1.Fos.plot<- 
    Fos%>%
    ggplot(aes(x=Age, y=CA1, fill=Genotype))+
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape=NA, alpha = 0.8)+  # alpha for transparency+
    geom_point(colour="black", size = 0.5, position=position_jitterdodge())+
    scale_fill_manual(values=GenotypeColour)+
    labs(y = "Fos+ cells/mm2", x= "Age (months)")+
    scale_x_discrete(labels=c("3","6","9"))+
    theme_classic2()+
    theme(axis.title=element_text(size=12), axis.text.x=element_text(size=12), axis.text.y=element_text(size=12))+
    theme(legend.position="none")

#VC 2-way ANOVA
VC.aov <- aov(VC ~ Genotype + Age + Genotype*Age, data=Fos)
summary(VC.aov)
Fos%>% pairwise_t_test(VC ~ Age, p.adjust.method="BH")

#VC boxplot
VC.Fos.plot<- 
  Fos%>%
  ggplot(aes(x=Age, y=gRSC, color=Genotype))+
  geom_boxplot()+
  geom_point(position=position_jitterdodge(jitter.width=0.0))+
  #stat_summary(fun.y = mean, geom = "errorbar", aes(ymax = ..y.., ymin = ..y.., group=Genotype), width = .7, linetype = "dashed", position=position_dodge())+
  labs(y = "Fos+ cells/mm2", x= "Age (months)")+
  scale_x_discrete(labels=c("3","6","9"))+
  theme_classic2()+
  theme(axis.title=element_text(size=20), axis.text.x=element_text(size=18), axis.text.y=element_text(size=16))+
  theme(legend.position="none")

#EC 2-way ANOVA
EC.aov <- aov(EC ~ Genotype + Age + Genotype*Age, data=Fos)
summary(EC.aov)
Fos%>% pairwise_t_test(EC ~ Age, p.adjust.method="BH")
Fos%>% group_by(Age)%>% pairwise_t_test(EC ~ Genotype, p.adjust.method = "BH")

#EC boxplot
  EC.Fos.plot<- 
    Fos%>%
    ggplot(aes(x=Age, y=EC, fill=Genotype))+
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape=NA, alpha = 0.8)+  # alpha for transparency+
    geom_point(colour="black", size = 0.5, position=position_jitterdodge())+
    scale_fill_manual(values=GenotypeColour)+
    labs(y = "Fos+ cells/mm2", x= "Age (months)")+
    scale_x_discrete(labels=c("3","6","9"))+
    theme_classic2()+
    theme(axis.title=element_text(size=12), axis.text.x=element_text(size=12), axis.text.y=element_text(size=12))+
    theme(legend.position="none")
#descriptive statistics
  
Fos%>%
  group_by(Age,Genotype)%>%
  summarise(mean=mean(CA1), SD=sd(CA1), median=median(CA1),IQR1=quantile(CA1,0.25),IQR3=quantile(CA1,0.75))
Fos%>%
  group_by(Age,Genotype)%>%
  summarise(mean=mean(EC), SD=sd(EC), median=median(EC),IQR1=quantile(EC,0.25),IQR3=quantile(EC,0.75))

#save boxplots and legend as SVG files
ggsave(file="CA1 Fos boxplot.pdf", plot=CA1.Fos.plot,height=3, width=3.5)
ggsave(file="EC Fos boxplot.pdf", plot=EC.Fos.plot, height=3, width=3.5)
#ggsave(file="genotype legend.pdf", plot=legend)
```

CA1 and EC 4-way ANOVA with sex included as IV
```{r}
CA1.aov_sex <- aov(CA1 ~ Genotype + Age + Sex + Genotype*Age + Sex*Age + Sex*Genotype, data=Fos)
summary(CA1.aov_sex)

EC.aov_sex <- aov(EC ~ Genotype + Age + Sex + Genotype*Age + Sex*Age + Sex*Genotype, data=Fos)
summary(EC.aov_sex)
```
AmyloGlo analysis: read in SPSS files
```{r}
#read in SPSS file to data frame
AG<-read.spss("J20_AmyloGlo_final.sav", use.value.label=TRUE, to.data.frame=TRUE)

#transposed file for mixed ANOVA
AG.tr<- read.spss("J20_AmyloGlo_transposed.sav", use.value.label=TRUE, to.data.frame=TRUE)
```
RSC % area covered analysis
```{r}
#3-way mixed ANOVA
AG_mixaov <- aov_ez(id="ID", dv="RSC", data=AG.tr, between=c("Age","Genotype"), within="Subregion")
summary(AG_mixaov)

#post hoc tests
AG%>% group_by(Genotype)%>% pairwise_t_test(dRSC ~ Age, p.adjust.method="BH")
AG%>% group_by(Genotype)%>% pairwise_t_test(gRSC ~ Age, p.adjust.method="BH")

#4-way mixed ANOVA with sex included as IV
AG_mixaov_sex <- aov_ez(id="ID", dv="RSC", data=AG.tr, between=c("Age","Genotype","Sex"), within="Subregion")
summary(AG_mixaov_sex)

#RSC %area covered boxplot
AG.mix.plot<- 
  AG.tr%>%
  ggplot(aes(x=Age, y=RSC_av, fill=Genotype))+
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape=NA, alpha = 0.8)+  # alpha for transparency
# geom_col()+
   geom_point(colour="black", size = 1, position=position_jitterdodge())+
  scale_fill_manual(values=GenotypeColour)+
  facet_wrap(vars(Subregion), ncol=2, scales="fixed")+
#  stat_summary(fun.y = mean, geom = "errorbar", aes(ymax = ..y.., ymin = ..y.., group=Genotype), width = .7, linetype = "dashed", position=position_dodge())+
  labs(y = "Area covered with plaque (%)", x= "Age (months)")+
  scale_x_discrete(labels=c("3","6","9"))+
  theme_classic2()+
  theme(axis.text.x=element_text(size=12), axis.text.y=element_text(size=12),
        strip.text=element_text(size=12), 
        legend.position="right")

AG.mix.plot2<- 
  AG.tr%>%
  ggplot(aes(x=Age, y=RSC_av, fill=Genotype))+
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape=NA, alpha = 0.8)+  # alpha for transparency
# geom_col()+
   geom_point(colour="black", size = 1, position=position_jitterdodge())+
  scale_fill_manual(values=GenotypeColour)+
  facet_wrap(vars(Subregion), ncol=2, scales="fixed")+
#  stat_summary(fun.y = mean, geom = "errorbar", aes(ymax = ..y.., ymin = ..y.., group=Genotype), width = .7, linetype = "dashed", position=position_dodge())+
  labs(y = "Area covered with plaque (µm2)", x= "Age (months)")+
  scale_x_discrete(labels=c("3","6","9"))+
  theme_classic2()+
  theme(axis.text.x=element_text(size=12), axis.text.y=element_text(size=12),
        strip.text=element_text(size=12), 
        legend.position="none")


#descriptive statistics
AG%>%
  group_by(Age,Genotype)%>%
  summarise(mean=mean(dRSC), SD=sd(dRSC), median=median(dRSC),IQR1=quantile(dRSC,0.25),IQR3=quantile(dRSC,0.75))
AG%>%
  group_by(Age,Genotype)%>%
  summarise(mean=mean(gRSC), SD=sd(gRSC), median=median(gRSC),IQR1=quantile(gRSC,0.25),IQR3=quantile(gRSC,0.75))

#save boxplot as SVG
ggsave(file="RSC AG boxplot.pdf", plot=AG.mix.plot, height=3, width=7)
ggsave(file="RSC AG boxplot area.pdf", plot=AG.mix.plot2, height=3, width=5)
```
RSC average plaque size analysis
```{r}
#filter out WT mice as previous analysis showed WT mice displauyed no plaques so would just be an ANOVA on zero data which would throw the stats
AG.Tg.tr <- filter(AG.tr, Genotype=="Tg")

#2-way mixed ANOVA
AG_mixaov_av <- aov_ez(id="ID", dv="RSC_av", data=AG.Tg.tr, between="Age", within="Subregion")
summary(AG_mixaov_av)
#post hoc tests
AG%>% pairwise_t_test(dRSC_av ~ Age, p.adjust.method="BH")
AG%>% pairwise_t_test(gRSC_av ~ Age, p.adjust.method="BH")

#3-way mixed ANOVA with sex included as IV
AG_mixaov_av_sex <- aov_ez(id="ID", dv="RSC_av", data=AG.Tg.tr, between=c("Age","Sex"), within="Subregion")
summary(AG_mixaov_av_sex)

#RSC plaque size boxplot
AG.mix.plot.av<- 
  AG.tr%>%
  ggplot(aes(x=Age, y=RSC_av, fill=Genotype))+
  geom_boxplot()+
  scale_fill_manual(values=GenotypeColour)+
  geom_point(col="black")+
  facet_wrap(vars(Subregion), ncol=2, scales="fixed")+
#  stat_summary(fun.y = mean, geom = "errorbar", aes(ymax = ..y.., ymin = ..y.., group=Genotype), width = .7, linetype = "dashed", col="#00BFC4", position=position_dodge())+
  labs(y = "Average plaque area (µm2)", x= "Age (months)")+
  scale_x_discrete(labels=c("3","6","9"))+
  theme_classic2()+
  theme(axis.text.x=element_text(size=12), axis.text.y=element_text(size=12),
        axis.title=element_text(size=12),
        strip.text=element_text(size=12), 
        legend.title=element_text(size=12), legend.text=element_text(size=12))

#descriptive statistics
AG%>%
  group_by(Age,Genotype)%>%
  summarise(mean=mean(dRSC_av), SD=sd(dRSC_av), median=median(dRSC_av),IQR1=quantile(dRSC_av,0.25),IQR3=quantile(dRSC_av,0.75))
AG%>%
  group_by(Age,Genotype)%>%
  summarise(mean=mean(gRSC_av), SD=sd(gRSC_av), median=median(gRSC_av),IQR1=quantile(gRSC_av,0.25),IQR3=quantile(gRSC_av,0.75))

#save as SVG file
ggsave(file="RSC AG area boxplot.pdf", plot=AG.mix.plot.av, height=3, width=7)

#unnecessary, just wanted to look at graphically separating by age
  AG.Tg.tr%>%
  ggplot(aes(x=Age, y=RSC_av, color=Sex))+
  geom_boxplot()+
  geom_point()+
  facet_wrap(vars(Subregion), ncol=2, scales="fixed")+
  stat_summary(fun.y = mean, geom = "errorbar", aes(ymax = ..y.., ymin = ..y.., group=Sex), width = .7, linetype = "dashed", col="#00BFC4", position=position_dodge())+
  labs(y = "Average surface area (um2)", x= "Age (months)")+
  scale_x_discrete(labels=c("3","6","9"))+
  theme_classic2()+
  theme(axis.text.x=element_text(size=30), axis.text.y=element_text(size=30),
        axis.title=element_text(size=36),
        strip.text=element_text(size=30), 
        legend.title=element_text(size=30), legend.text=element_text(size=30))
```

CA1 average plaque size analysis
```{r}
#filter out WT mice
AG.Tg <- filter(AG, Genotype=="Tg")

#CA1 1-way ANOVA

AG.Tg%>% pairwise_t_test(CA1_av ~ Age, p.adjust.method="BH")

#CA1 plaque size boxplot
CA1.AG.plot.av<- 
  AG.Tg%>%
  ggplot(aes(x=Age, y=CA1_av))+
  geom_boxplot(col="#00BFC4")+
  geom_point(col="#00BFC4")+
  stat_summary(fun.y = mean, geom = "errorbar", aes(ymax = ..y.., ymin = ..y.., group=Genotype), width = .7, linetype = "dashed", col="#00BFC4")+
  labs(y = "Average surface area (um2)", x= "Age (months)")+
  scale_x_discrete(labels=c("3","6","9"))+
  theme_classic2()+
  theme(axis.title=element_text(size=36), axis.text.x=element_text(size=30), axis.text.y=element_text(size=30))+
  theme(legend.position="none")

#descriptive statistics
AG%>%
  group_by(Age,Genotype)%>%
  summarise(mean=mean(CA1_av), SD=sd(CA1_av), median=median(CA1_av),IQR1=quantile(CA1_av,0.25),IQR3=quantile(CA1_av,0.75))

#save as SVG file
ggsave(file="CA1 AG area boxplot.pdf", plot=CA1.AG.plot.av, height=10, width=8)
```

  stat_summary(fun.y = mean, geom = "errorbar", aes(ymax = ..y.., ymin = ..y.., group=Genotype), width = .7, linetype = "dashed", position=position_dodge())+
  labs(y = "% Area", x= "Age (months)")+
  scale_x_discrete(labels=c("3","6","9"))+
  theme_classic2()+
  theme(axis.title=element_text(size=36), axis.text.x=element_text(size=30), axis.text.y=element_text(size=30))+
  theme(legend.position="none")
  
  AG.Tg%>%
  ggplot(aes(x=Age, y=lEC_av, color=Sex))+
